Validation

Gate B shared records v1

10 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓
On this page ↓
META (once, first)Full boundary without a production hookSAMPLE (profile mode only)Additive normal-only streamsRESULT (once, last)Optional Native observer records

Test-only protocol, plain JSON lines. Events are GATE_B_META, GATE_B_SAMPLE, GATE_B_RESULT; every record has schema:1 and the SAME nonempty run_id. One stream contains one framework/fixture/mode/build only. No timing job is authorized merely by this document. Root grants exclusivity.

META (once, first)#

Required keys:

  • framework: kit or replay.
  • timing_mode: functional_only or profile.
  • fixture: {id,profile_hex,descriptor_sha256,initial_dynamic,reference_peak}. IDs are exactly dense32_boxes_extra_sphere / profile 504859534e455431 and common32_spheres_crates_extra_capsule / 534c494345503031. initial_dynamic=32. Reference peaks are respectively {bodies:35,shapes:35,contacts:141,joints:1} and {bodies:35,shapes:35,contacts:122,joints:1}. These are labelled historical references, not fabricated measured sample counts. Descriptor hash binds the actual geometry, placement, hinge, damping, input/action schedule and seed.
  • execution: {core,ownership,native_linkage,transport,native_images}. core: actual_godot_core, registry_fake_core, or none; ownership: sdk_meter or nil_owner; linkage shared_dso or static_diagnostic; transport offline_public_packets or actual_enet. Final CPU candidate eligibility requires actual Core + SDK Meter + one shared native image. Fake-Core and nilOwner remain separate diagnostic groups. Offline public serialized packet CPU fixtures do NOT prove live ENet soak.
  • identity: {os,arch,configuration,godot,source_manifest_sha256, core_binary_sha256,script_binary_sha256,native_binary_sha256, native_build_sha256,native_target_sha256}. All hashes are64 lowercase hex/nonzero. Use exact artifacts, not caller labels. Configuration is explicit.
  • limits: {normal_ns:4000000,repair8_ns:4000000,hz:60,substeps:4, history:128,prediction:8,ordinary_repair:8,bodies:35,shapes:35,contacts:147, joints:1,tracked_bytes:67108864}. Timers are acceptance observations only.
  • boundary: {id,receiver_entry,clock_domain,clock_resolution_ns, included_work,excluded_work,source_refs}. Full ID core_public_ingress_v1; lower diagnostic ID lower_diagnostic_v1. Full receiver entries: session_frame, link_pump_then_client_pump, session_dispatch_then_lane_frame. client_pump_only is lower-boundary diagnostic if input already bypassed Link dispatch/reassembly. The two additive normal-only entries below require their exact declared kind; they are never full repair8 boundaries. clock_domain=godot_ticks_usec, clock_resolution_ns=1000 for actual Core. Source refs are {path,symbol,sha256} for the test method and required public pipeline entries. Composite C internals are source-audited coverage, not individually timed phases unless an actual existing timing hook measures them.
  • sample_plan: {normal:N,repair8:M} exact timed counts, fixed BEFORE run. Functional-only uses both0. A complete CPU candidate needs both positive.

included_work lists actual coverage, using these exact names:

Normal: public_dispatch, normal_step_capture_admission, required_serialization, publication_events, operation_cleanup, core_return.

Repair8: public_dispatch, envelope_reassembly_inspect, canonical_native_read_build_verify_reencode, typed_decode, accepted_input_replay, complete_paired_compare, publication_events, operation_cleanup, core_return.

Kit ordinary wire-v2 repair is selected only by META framework:"kit" and descriptor.wire_revision with integer value2. Its repair8 coverage replaces canonical_native_read_build_verify_reencode with canonical_five_part_signature_verification; every other required operation above remains inside the whole call. The descriptor must explicitly declare native_recovery_read_in_operation:false. Native recovery-read coverage is forbidden under this ordinary signature-repair branch.

Each such SAMPLE supplies integer accepted_packets:1, signature_packets:1, signatures_before, signatures_after, full_states_before, full_states_after. Matched-signature delta must be1; full-state receives must stay unchanged from an actual bootstrap count of at least1. counter_kind:"model_step_callback" identifies the observed actual_steps_* delta8; it is not a Native engine-step counter. All prior complete-five-part equality/hash, publication, tick, quota, cleanup, source/binary, outer-clock and4ms rules remain unchanged. No absent, wire1, differently typed/versioned or Replay metadata selects this branch. sample_findings(sample, meta=None) preserves legacy requirements by default; the analyzer passes the stream's actual validated META explicitly.

Use the union of ONLY the predeclared sample_plan operations in META. A normal0/repair8-positive probe must not fabricate normal work; its overall CPU candidate remains INCOMPLETE without normal coverage. Functional-only zero-sample META declares the actual complete functional pipeline (normal or repair8), not an unused union. Actual operation-specific coverage is repeated in SAMPLE. Missing required coverage makes CPU acceptance INCOMPLETE, not a faster pass. Exclude only declared network_wait, render, diagnostic_output and diagnostic_resource_read. Mandatory validation/comparison/cleanup cannot be relabelled diagnostic. Reference/input preparation is source-described; actual receiver dispatch, canonical validation and required paired comparison remain inside the timed operation.

Full boundary without a production hook#

A test-only GDScript caller reads Time.get_ticks_usec() immediately BEFORE node.call(test_method) and immediately AFTER it returns. This includes Core entry, typed producer work, operation cleanup and the entire return through Core. The method must contain the public ingress path and required work above. Read phase/result diagnostics in a SEPARATE method and serialize/write them after the outer timer. No renderer, JSON, printf or file capture inside the timed method. Do not move required cleanup or comparison into the diagnostic method.

SAMPLE (profile mode only)#

Required keys:

  • seq: consecutive1..N; operation: normal or repair8.
  • epoch,base_tick,head_before,head_after,confirmed_before,confirmed_after. base_tick is the predecessor BEFORE the first replayed tick. For repair8, head_before-base_tick==8; no from-tick inclusive/exclusive ambiguity.
  • requested_depth:0 for normal,8 for repair8.
  • actual_steps_before,actual_steps_after: operation-local observed step counter values, not a literal copied from requested_depth. Normal delta1; repair8 delta8. Any failed/short/noop attempt remains recorded and cannot be silently discarded as an ineligible fast success. The additive normal-only invariant below instead requires both fields explicitly null (unavailable), with no invented native/replay counter. Default counter semantics, including every existing repair8 stream, remain unchanged.
  • outcome: committed, rejected, hold_resync, or error.
  • outer_start_us,outer_end_us,whole_ns with whole_ns==(outer_end_us-outer_start_us)*1000 and whole_ns>0. Normal requires head_after=head_before+1. Reference repair8 requires head_after=head_before, confirmed_before=base_tick and confirmed_after=head_before. Both before/after confirmation<=head and head-confirmed<=8. Failed/short/noop records remain raw and fail acceptance.
  • included_work: actual operation coverage names above.
  • proof: {full_state_equal,publication_atomic,quota_ok, expected_complete_sha256,actual_complete_sha256}. Equality refers to ALL Solver/Game/Side/Observations/Occurrences. Equal motion hash is insufficient. Hashes bind actual complete data; source describes the byte comparison.
  • counts: actual observed {bodies,shapes,contacts,joints}. State if observations include candidates vs only published worlds in optional counts_scope.
  • ledger: actual {live_bytes,reserved_bytes,admitted_bytes,limit_bytes, committed_peak_bytes,storage_bytes}. Require live+reserved=admitted and the unchanged64MiB cap. The peak is the combined ledger's observed highwater, not a sum of unrelated component peaks. SourceQuota/Meter paths remain active.
  • phases: array of optional measured spans (empty is honest): {name,duration_ns,clock_domain,start_us,end_us,relation}. Same-Godot-clock spans may include absolute start/end and must fit outer bounds. Odin/native durations with another origin use start_us:null,end_us:null, labelled clock_domain and relation such as nested_in_canonical_decode. NEVER subtract cross-clock origins or sum nested timings into whole_ns. Existing profile callback durations may be emitted as operation-local spans; repeated names are allowed and retained, not averaged away before analysis.
  • Optional rss_sampled_bytes / rss_process_peak_bytes, with actual source/unit identified in META. Sampled RSS is not an unsampled staging peak or64MiB claim.

All raw samples, including cold and over-target values, stay in input/output. Nearest-rank p50/p95 and actual maximum are computed per exact stream/category; there is no outlier discard or sum of marginal percentiles. The4ms candidate ceiling is checked against EACH whole eligible call, never core-only timings.

Additive normal-only streams#

These two categories use separate descriptors, record streams and percentiles:

Fixed META.normal_kind Required boundary.receiver_entry
client_prediction_send link_pump_then_client_step
authority_step_requested_canonical server_step_then_requested_snapshot_pump

Both require META.step_observation="committed_tick_require_step". Profile mode declares exactly {normal:19,repair8:0}; functional-only declares {normal:0,repair8:0} and emits no SAMPLE or new timing reads. Each SAMPLE repeats the identical normal_kind and step_observation, has operation="normal" and requested_depth=0, and includes these additional proof fields:

JSON
{
  "successful_public_step": true,
  "external_require_step": true,
  "committed_tick_before": 159,
  "committed_tick_after": 160
}

actual_steps_before and actual_steps_after are mandatory null values in these streams. The proof uses actual published tick observations and the successful public step under an enabled External.require_step contract; it does not claim an independent native/global/replayed-tick counter. Proof ticks must match head_before/head_after, advance exactly one tick and have base_tick=head_before. Client prediction leaves confirmation unchanged; authority work starts and ends with confirmed=head. The usual eight-tick unconfirmed window, all full-state/quota/atomicity proofs and cleanup remain hard. False step-success/require-step flags, no-op/extra ticks, errors and over-target samples remain retained failures. Mixing kinds or repair8 into either stream, using the new entries without their declared kind, or inventing counter values is rejected. Legacy streams without these fields retain their existing rules.

Human source review is mandatory before interpreting these records as CPU evidence: verify the actual ph.step path, enabled provider require_step, failure propagation before publication, actual outer Core return, all required serialization/ownership work and independent full-five-part reference. Bind the relevant test/provider/public-step sources in boundary.source_refs and the existing compiled/runtime artifact map. Boolean record claims alone do not prove that source contract. A client normal includes its real INPUT serialization/send; it does not invent a per-prediction canonical solver export. The authority entry is the explicitly declared offline step plus correlated public-request canonical egress composite, not a claim about live snapshot cadence or ENet throughput.

All NORMAL_WORK coverage, including required_serialization, still applies in profile and functional mode. No mandatory work may move outside the outer timer. Normal19/repair0 remains overall CPU-candidate INCOMPLETE for missing repair coverage even if all19 calls meet4ms. Per-stream raw/p50/p95/max and each-call4ms failures remain visible. Never pool the two normal categories or relabel them as the dense repair8/common live-scene/long-soak gate.

RESULT (once, last)#

Required keys: sample_count, functional_operations, correctness_ok, source_fence_unchanged, binary_fence_unchanged, cleanup.

Cleanup is actual {native_live_bytes,snapshot_live_bytes,host_application_live_bytes, all_explicit_drops_ok,core_shutdown_clean,ownership_evidence}. ownership_evidence names direct counters OR checked explicit drops + Meter0; never invent a direct owner count. Include actual available owner/callback/mark counts separately. Stable Core/ledger storage is separately labelled and is not pretended to be application bytes0. Query failures/missing counters cannot become synthetic zero. Root retains process natural exits and shutdown logs.

Functional-only mode emits NO SAMPLE and performs NO added profile clock reads. Use RESULT sample_count0 and actual functional_operations count/proofs. Existing runtime delivery/diagnostic clocks remain unchanged. Functional success returns NOT_MEASURED timing status, never0ns or CPU acceptance.

Optional Native observer records#

Legacy records without META.native_observer keep their rules. This opt-in is TEST-RECORDS only; it does not authorize a timing run or change game outcomes. META.native_observer has these exact fields:

Text
abi_version:1, mode:off|structure_only|timed,
block_bytes:49392, span_bytes:48, capacity:1024, stack_capacity:16,
phase_mask:4095, clock_domain:godot_ticks_usec,
native_static_bytes:48, binding_control_bytes:32, clock_binding_static_bytes:24,
meter_context_bytes:219928, overhead:inside_whole,
native_status_names:{...}, source_phase_map:[{phase,name,path,symbol,sha256},...]

The three static/control/cache sizes are explicitly labelled instrumentation storage, not successful Native allocation requests. Actual Meter context/block allocation remains charged once; source audit verifies the exact leases and global resource ledger. Fields are not permission to hide or double-count memory. Status keys are decimal strings:0..7 map to the exact C names OGB3_OK, OGB3_INVALID_ARGUMENT, OGB3_INVALID_HANDLE, OGB3_OUT_OF_MEMORY, OGB3_CAPACITY, OGB3_UNSUPPORTED, OGB3_INCOMPATIBLE, OGB3_CORRUPT; -2147483648 is UNAVAILABLE, never fake success0.

The sorted12-entry source map binds phases1..12 and their names below to the actual hashed C source sites. Every path/hash must also occur in ordinary boundary.source_refs, so existing artifact-map verification binds it. Symbol placement remains subject to actual source review. Initial mask4095 excludes separately proposed phases13..15; no silent extra selection.

IDs Names
1 native.step.fixed
2..6 native.snapshot.capture, native.snapshot.serialize, native.snapshot.normalize, native.snapshot.finalize, native.snapshot.validate
7 native.admission.world
8..12 native.recovery.read, native.recovery.parse_validate, native.recovery.build, native.recovery.verify_reencode, native.recovery.write

Mode timed requires profile mode and a nonempty top-level META.exclusive_grant containing the ACTUAL Root grant label. A label alone never self-authorizes a run. Functional-only allows off/structure_only, no SAMPLE, no added clock/prewarm.

Raw SAMPLE and derived phases#

SAMPLE.native_observation is the CLOSED actual C block header, exact fields:

Text
abi_version,struct_bytes,mode,capacity,count,stack_depth,error_flags,state,
scope_token,domain_cookie,next_span_id,root_count,clock_reads,clock_errors,
overflow_count,nesting_errors,last_clock_us,phase_mask,stack,spans

Header values use their actual u32/u64 integer ranges, never JSON doubles/bools. stack is exactly16 u64s. spans contains exactly count written slots (<=1024), each with EXACTLY seven keys:

Text
id,parent_id,root_ordinal,phase,native_status,start_us,end_us

No status-name strings or extra keys occur in raw spans. Span IDs are contiguous BEGIN ordinals; parent is0 or an earlier recorded ID; roots are counted/ordered and inherited by children. Closed state is2, mode2 for timed SAMPLE, ABI1 and struct_bytes49392. Valid closed stacks are allzero; next_span_id=count+1; clock_reads=2*count in a valid timed record, with last_clock_us matching the last actual boundary. Empty selection, unknown status, invalid state/mode/IDs/parents/ roots or clock/nesting/overflow errors are observation failures.

For valid observations every raw span has ONE derived entry in SAMPLE.phases, with ordinary phase fields plus EXACT extras native_span_id, native_parent_id, native_root_ordinal, native_phase, native_status. Name is the fixed mapped name, relation=native_nested_in_whole, same-Godot absolute start/end and duration_ns=(end_us-start_us)*1000. Parents/children/whole intervals must contain one another; root intervals are sequential. No sums, subtractions, residual claims, rewritten statuses or overhead correction.

Narrow failed-observation encoding: actual nonzero raw error_flags, clock_errors, overflow_count, nesting_errors or stack_depth may instead have ZERO Native-derived entries. Keep ALL raw header/stack/spans EXACTLY, and retain other existing phases. This avoids unsigned-wrap/negative/fake0 valid durations after a clock failure. It STILL fails observation acceptance; actual game outcome, state/proof and resources remain separately recorded. A bad model outcome alone does not permit omission; valid error-free observations always require one-for-one derivation. Never forge CLOSED or erase an error to make a sample eligible.

Functional and final untimed result#

RESULT.native_clock_prewarm_calls is0 for functional off/structure and1 for the explicit timed profile setup. Functional off has RESULT.native_observation:null. Structure-only has the exact closed raw block with mode1, clock_reads0, last_clock_us0 and all raw times0 labelled UNAVAILABLE; no timing SAMPLE. Optional RESULT.native_functional_scopes retains at most20 such raw structure blocks before reuse. Any aggregate native_observation_summary is diagnostic only and cannot replace those raw entries.

For the rolling19 profile, META.mode timed describes ONLY19 timed SAMPLEs at heads8..152. Final160 remains an UNTImed oracle: RESULT.native_observation is its closed structure block (mode1/no callback reads), with profile prewarm count1. There is no synthetic SAMPLE160 and no pretend timed final block. Errors in a functional/final block are hard observation failures, not a faster game result.

The shared analyzer reports CPU candidate PASS/FAIL/INCOMPLETE/DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY. It NEVER declares the whole Gate B passed: long two-process ENet correctness, impairment/recovery schedule, rolling evidence, memory/RSS and Root review remain separate mandatory requirements. P5 remains blocked until Root's explicit Gate B.
